scope: One phone enrollment, one Photon memory message, one same-enrollment web follow-up, one access-ending negative message. No device-control or music experiment is required.

offline_readiness.new_regression: Implicit exact-cookie recovery waiting for enrollment lock is revoked before lock release:404 INVITATION_EXPIRED; no new allocation, native turn, credential or deadline change.

preconditions: Root deploys the reviewed retry patch with TENANT_PHOTON_ENABLED=1 and existing conversation/thread/anchor configuration; no new native chat.
Root confirms the configured room invitation from the current display; do not hard-code an old code.
One current online say bridge; default audio output and volume remain as Jay selected.
Record baseline native turn IDs and Photon claim count privately; leave unrelated room work idle for this short check.
Never print API keys, phone handles, guest tokens, cookies, sms links with phone handles, or chat URL fragments.

sequence.operator: Root guides one phone through Text the room in the original browser tab.
pass: POST /join returns200 and required fields are present (record only booleans).
Exactly one live joining/active lease and active binding correspond; no native cmd/new inbound claim before the phone actually texts.
If the same phone form is repeated with its original cookie, the same guest, credential and original deadlines are returned; no allocation or native call.
sequence.failure_evidence: Record only error.code and HTTP status plus safe JOIN_REJECTED audit. Do not repeatedly allocate or resend on an unknown outcome.

sequence.operator: Within120 seconds of enrollment, replace the SMS draft with: Our demo word is <fresh word>. Please confirm it briefly. Send once.
pass: Exactly one new durable claim for the verified received direct message; outcome reaches ACCEPTED.
Exactly one native cmd and final ok on the configured fixed thread, correlated by the same guest and turn; actual stored input/final answer verified privately.
Phone user confirms an iMessage reply mentioning the fresh word arrived.
sequence.limit: ACCEPTED / ACCEPTED_NOT_DELIVERED is not evidence of actual phone delivery.

sequence.operator: During the same brief reply, user listens to the Mac without changing output or volume.
pass: Speech audit is for the same guest/thread/turn/generation and audio_status ACKNOWLEDGED.
User confirms the Mac actually spoke a meaningful response.
sequence.limit: A speech acknowledgement alone does not prove audibility. Texting may pass while room speech remains unconfirmed.

sequence.operator: Return to the SAME original browser tab and use its Chat here fallback. Ask: What is our demo word?
pass: Guest ID, credential and original expiry are unchanged.
Reply gives the fresh word; one additional native turn is appended on the SAME fixed thread/generation, without new guest admission or history reset.
If audio is included, separately confirm the second reply was heard.
sequence.do_not: Do not start a fresh /j join; that intentionally creates a new guest and resets working context.

sequence.operator: After replies settle, root either uses authenticated /host/revoke for this guest or waits until its ORIGINAL expires_at; record which transition actually ran. Then send one further message from the old Messages thread.
pass: The exact old lease is released/expired locally and absent from active guest state.
No new native cmd, accepted reply or speech occurs for that guest after the end time. A fresh rejected inbound normally creates NO claim because matching rejects it before claim.
A known adapter-owned assignment yields RELEASED after successful cleanup; a reused external assignment yields DETACHED_PREEXISTING; network uncertainty yields CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED.
sequence.observation: Observe at least10 seconds under healthy polling. If provider delivery/polling is not established, classify the live negative result as inconclusive rather than claiming proven local denial.
sequence.limit: Manual revoke does not prove real timed expiry. Keep expiry marked offline-only unless the original timer actually expires. Already submitted replies/effects cannot be unsent.

safe_evidence_fields.timing_limit: These are separate stage timings. Do not label API acceptance or speech acknowledgement as phone delivery/acoustic latency.

overall_acceptance: Report channel/native shared-context, phone delivery, room audio and access-ending separately. One passing trial establishes a bounded working path, not reliability. No native-app visual rendering claim unless separately seen.
